description: Vendor checks: sanctions lists, SEC filings, domain age and a due-diligence report with sources.
name: Pyxmark

tools.name: search_company
tools.title: Search SEC companies
tools.description: Look up which SEC-registered company a name, ticker or CIK refers to. Returns up to 10 candidates, each with its CIK, tickers and a match score, and nothing else. Use it to pick the right CIK when a name is ambiguous, then call company_profile with that CIK for the details.

tools.name: company_profile
tools.title: SEC company profile
tools.description: Full SEC EDGAR record for one company, given its CIK, ticker or name (best match): legal name, industry (SIC), state of incorporation, business address, 3 fiscal years of revenue, net income, total assets and cash, and its recent 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K filings with links. Use search_company first if you only have a partial or ambiguous name.

tools.name: screen_sanctions
tools.title: Screen sanctions lists
tools.description: Fuzzy-screen a person or organisation name against OFAC SDN + Consolidated, UN, EU, and UK sanctions lists. Returns up to 15 scored matches with source links; if more match, the summary says so and suggests a more specific query. Optional dob/birth_year, nationality and country set aside same-name matches whose listed details differ (rules at https://mcp.pyxmark.com/#details). Optional address, email, phone, website, ids and owners are matched against the details the lists give (identifier matches, sanctioned regions, the 50 percent rule); the assessment field sums it up as hold / review / clear. Informational only, not a compliance determination. Results come from public government lists and filings, may be incomplete or out of date, and fuzzy name matches can be false positives or miss variants. Verify every potential match against the official source before acting.

dob.description: Optional: date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD) of the person, to tell them apart from others with the same name

birth_year.description: Optional: birth year, if the full date isn't known

nationality.description: Optional: the person's nationality (country name or ISO code)

country.description: Optional: country where the person lives or the organisation is based

address.description: Optional: street address or city (free text). Flags addresses in comprehensively sanctioned regions: Crimea, the so-called DNR/LNR, Iran, North Korea, Cuba (Syria is flagged for review)

email.description: Optional: contact email, matched against emails and domains the lists give

phone.description: Optional: phone number, matched on its last 9 digits against phones the lists give

website.description: Optional: website or domain, matched against websites the lists give

ids.description: Optional: identifiers to match against the lists: company registration or tax numbers, passport or national ID numbers, vessel IMO numbers, SWIFT/BIC codes, crypto addresses

owners.description: Optional: owners and their share (percent). Each is screened; listed owners holding 50% or more in total make the company blocked under the OFAC 50 percent rule

subject_type.description: Optional: whether the name is a company or a person. Defaults to company when the name has a legal suffix such as Inc or LLC (or, in a report, when it is an SEC-registered company); then person, vessel and aircraft entries must match almost exactly.

tools.name: domain_age
tools.title: Domain age and email records
tools.description: Domain registration date, age, registrar (RDAP) and email-auth records (MX, SPF, DMARC), which are common fraud signals, plus first_archived: the date of the Wayback Machine's earliest snapshot (null if none; archive.status says unavailable if archive.org didn't answer). notes holds factual remarks, such as a first snapshot under 90 days old or a registration years older than the first snapshot; they are not flags.

tools.name: state_registry_link
tools.title: State business registry link
tools.description: Official Secretary of State business-search link for a US state, to verify a private company's status, formation date, and registered agent.

tools.name: due_diligence_report
tools.title: Vendor due diligence report
tools.description: One-call due-diligence report: SEC profile (if public), sanctions screen, federal exclusions, domain signals (registration age, email records, Wayback Machine first-seen date), and state registry link, with a red-flag summary, a verdict (clear / review / hold; rules at https://mcp.pyxmark.com/#verdict) and source links. An agent should not pay or onboard on 'hold', and should ask a person on 'review'. Informational only, not a compliance determination. Results come from public government lists and filings, may be incomplete or out of date, and fuzzy name matches can be false positives or miss variants. Verify every potential match against the official source before acting.
